w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They settled names for 2 beasts: "Ugly-Eyes", "Old Gavel".

w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — The Callback. It's here.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds Ella — no dodging it.
firstContext: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds Ella — no dodging it.
📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: The Secret Deck. Cards against the System's dealer. The deck is made of village secrets — every card drawn reveals something true about someone watching."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/11/6), with 2 wave-4 fought, 12 contests survived, 5 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 38 → 24 · capped · Craft 6 · Talk 20 · Explore 34 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Owen returns from the wilds hurt (health 7/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.

✨ CAPSTONE: Truth Lenses. The world, unredacted. Lies show up as smudges. Hidden things show up as outlines. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
